initial_prototype_diagnosis.window: Qwen PP1 EP8 CP2 S8192 MBS1 GBS64 BF16, step 6 rank 0, force-balanced routing
initial_prototype_diagnosis.observed: Prototype has less compute time but more copy time, communication-only time and idle time. Extra output bytes are dominated by stage5 backward gradient (83.375 GiB/rank/step) and forward saved hidden states (10.421875 GiB).
initial_prototype_diagnosis.hypothesis: First-free slot selection at the live-activation bound reuses the just-retired backward input. stage4_f then waits for that backward read although ordinary stage4_f only needs the earlier forward event. This can serialize forward combine with backward computation. Test FIFO plus one spare without changing capture or copies.
initial_prototype_diagnosis.caution: This is a matched profile decomposition, not a proof that all lost overlap is caused by buffer reuse. Profile overhead affects wall time; rely on the unprofiled ablation for performance.
